item.title: Powershell 配置文件启动加速
item.description:
在 powershell 的配置文件 $PROFILE 稍微增加了一些命令插件如 starship 会导致启动时间迅速增加，体验非常差！

基准测试

参考 Optimizing your $Profile

Measure-Command

使用 Measure-Command 测量运行脚本 $PROFILE 所需的时间

$count = 10
$noprofile_total_dur = 0
1..$count | ForEach-Object {
 Write-Progress -Id 1 -Activity 'pwsh' -PercentComplete $_
 $noprofile_total_dur += (Measure-Command {
 pwsh -noprofile -command 1
 }).TotalMilliseconds
}
Write-Progress -id 1 -Activity 'profile' -Completed
$noprofile_dur = $noprofile_total_dur / $count

$profile_total_dur = 0
1..$count | ForEach-Object {
 Write-Progress -Id 1 -Activity 'profile' -PercentComplete $_
 $profile_total_dur += (Measure-Command {
 pwsh -command 1
 }).TotalMilliseconds
}
Write-Progress -id 1 -activity 'profile' -Completed
$profile_dur = $profile_total_dur / $count

$baseline_dur = $profile_dur - $noprofile_dur
$baseline_dur

优化后目前仅需要 385.07156ms

缓存

在 ohmyzsh 中通常有类似 ohmyzsh/plugins/docker/docker.plugin.zsh 文件后置缓存

{
 # `docker completion` is only available from 23.0.0 on
 # docker version returns `Docker version 24.0.2, build cb74dfcd85`
 # with `s:,:` remove the comma after the version, and select third word of it
 if zstyle -t ':omz:plugins:docker' legacy-completion || \
 ! is-at-least 23.0.0 ${${(s:,:z)"$(command docker --version)"}[3]}; then
 command cp "${0:h}/completions/_docker" "$ZSH_CACHE_DIR/completions/_docker"
 else
 command docker completion zsh | tee "$ZSH_CACHE_DIR/completions/_docker" > /dev/null
 fi
} &|

这个 {} &| 在首次启动后运行命令将输出到缓存文件 _docker 中，由于首次启动不存在 _docker 文件所以不会加载，只有到下次启动才会加载这个 _docker 文件，并且如果 docker 命令版本更新后也会更新缓存，虽然需要 2 次重启 zsh 才有效，但这是非常有效的！

对于 powershell 来说，在启动时使用 Start-Job 或 Start-Process 启动后台进程更新缓存同样能大幅减少启动时间

在 Profiling and asynchronous initialization to improve PowerShell startup 中提到使用 # Register-EngineEvent 根据事件加载运行代码

1

Register-EngineEvent -SourceIdentifier PowerShell.OnIdle -MaxTriggerCount 1 -Action { $Host.UI.WriteLine("Hello, World!") }

# Create a queue of modules to load
[System.Collections.Queue]$__initQueue = @(
 {
 oh-my-posh init pwsh | Invoke-Expression
 $Env:POSH_GIT_ENABLED = $true
 },
 {

 },
 {

 },
 {
 $Env:PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8'
 New-Module -Name thefuck -ScriptBlock { iex "$(thefuck --alias)" } | Import-Module -Global
 }
)

# Register our idle callback; use `-SupportEvent` to hide the registration from the user
Register-EngineEvent -SourceIdentifier PowerShell.OnIdle -SupportEvent -Action {
 if ($__initQueue.Count -gt 0) {
 & $__initQueue.Dequeue()
 } else {
 # NOTE: Use `-Force` when unregistering because we used `-SupportEvent` when registering
 Unregister-Event -SubscriptionId $EventSubscriber.SubscriptionId -Force

 # Remove our queue variable to avoid polluting the environment
 Remove-Variable -Name '__initQueue' -Scope Global -Force

 # Re-render the prompt so we get pretty colors ASAP!
 [Microsoft.PowerShell.PSConsoleReadLine]::InvokePrompt()
 }
